issue_title: [Bug] Inconsistent text handling: rename() strips whitespace but constructor does not

root_cause_analysis.notes: Identified inconsistency: rename() strips whitespace but constructor and from_dict() do not, leading to different behavior for same logical operation

test_coverage.notes: Added two regression tests: test_todo_constructor_strips_whitespace and test_todo_from_dict_strips_whitespace

minimal_fix.notes: Single line fix in __post_init__ to strip text - minimal and targeted

no_regressions.notes: All 12 existing tests pass, no behavior changes for already-stripped text

code_quality.notes: Follows existing code style, uses same .strip() approach as rename() method

risks: Existing data with whitespace in text fields will be stripped on load/reconstruction
summary: Fixed inconsistent text handling by adding text.strip() in __post_init__, ensuring constructor and from_dict() behave consistently with rename() method
